notes.title: Inspector Waffles Early Days Release Date: November 15!
notes.notes:
The wait is over. Three years later, Waffles is finally back in a new retro adventure.🐱🕵️

Inspector Waffles Early Days will be released on November 15th on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614580/Inspector_Waffles_Early_Days/

Thanks for your support through the years, Waffles has been part of my life for the last seven years, and I'm super happy to finally share this new story. I hope you'll like it too :)

Take care ! 

Yann
